class_id: a value-clearing answer state is given by default instead of by proof
feature: the document extractor's answer state (scraper/scripts/answer_states.py, extract_filing.Emitter) and any reader that decides REFUSED or STATED_NOT_PRINTED, the two states OD-153 / OD-158 act on by CLEARING a stored value
symptom: Two shapes of one mechanism. (1) A failed check was read as REFUSED whenever a value was present, without asking whether the check could be judged: an inline presence check such as (ofs_amount is not None, ...) failed on an unread input and the field went out REFUSED carrying a value the reader never read. (2) A stated absence was decided from a phrase anywhere on a table row, not from the field's own cell: 'Not Applicable' in the cap-multiple column nulled the WACA column too. Both errors push a stored value toward deletion; the safe default (MISSED, keep the stored value) was the fallback instead of the rule.
first_seen: 2026-10-01 (#1429 round 1 review). Real fixtures, round 1 vs round 2 over all committed extractor page fixtures (991 field records): issue_structure REFUSED -> MISSED on 4 real filings (a-one-steels DRHP cover, acevector RHP cover, german-green RHP cover, moneyview RHP cover, each read as PRICE_BAND_AD with no OFS row read); Deepa price band ad (scraper/tests/fixtures/extractor/deepa-price-band-ad-pages.json, page 1 line 72 'Last three years 0.00(1) (2) Not Applicable Nil(3) - 80.00(1)') waca_last_3y STATED_NOT_PRINTED -> VALUE 0.0. No other record changed.
fix_prs: #1429 round 2 (fix/1420-extractor-answer-states): answer_states.Refused is the opt-in REFUSED marker, returned only by a check branch reached with every judged input present or by judge() on a present value; a plain (False, detail) is MISSED. WACA rows are split into cells (extract_filing._waca_row_cells); bonus_nil and not_applicable_no_qualifying_transaction are read from the field's own cell
detection_check: scraper/scripts/test_extract_filing_answer_states.py: test_every_check_function_is_classified (a new check_* must be listed as refusing or never-refusing), test_a_check_refuses_only_when_every_judged_input_is_present (each judged input set to None must answer MISSED), test_a_plain_failed_tuple_is_missed_even_with_a_value, test_an_unread_ofs_row_leaves_issue_structure_missed_not_refused, test_deepa_last_three_years_reads_each_field_from_its_own_cell. Unit and fixture level only; no live check counts REFUSED or STATED_NOT_PRINTED answers on real documents
status: unguarded in production: the tests guard the extractor's own checks; readers outside extract_filing.py and cross-field checks that mark every covered field REFUSED (post-offer shares) are decided per field in the OD-153 consumer PR
